propositions: CodeQL reports two high-severity incomplete-url-substring-sanitization alerts on lines 249–250 of test_llm_fallback_chain.py because assertions use startswith() to check URL prefixes instead of comparing parsed origins.
The startswith() pattern accepts URLs that merely share the configured endpoint as a prefix (e.g., https://fallback.test.evil.example/), failing to verify the actual host.
The test intent is to verify that a fallback entry is built against the configured endpoint, not the provider default, but the prefix check is insufficient to enforce that property.
Replacing startswith() with exact equality on parsed URL origins via _origin(url) = (scheme, netloc) from urllib.parse.urlsplit eliminates the substring ambiguity and clears both alerts.
After the fix, the test correctly rejects prefix-sharing look-alikes and remains green when the fallback endpoint threading is intact, while failing red when endpoint threading is disrupted.
